company.name: Silverfin
company.shortDescription: Silverfin is the cloud platform for automated financial reporting and value-added client advisory services.
company.description:
Silverfin is the cloud platform that makes accountants successful. It improves the efficiency, competitiveness and profitability of compliance services, and powers the development and delivery of advisory services.

Silverfin takes financial data directly from client systems and hosts it securely in a single cloud Structured Data Hub. Templates then standardise, and automate, accounting workflows and use the data hub to make compliance easy, fast, and accurate.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud platform for accounting firms that centralizes client financial data and automates post-accounting, compliance, reporting, workflow, and collaboration processes.
productsAndServices.name: Silverfin Platform

productsAndServices.description: Cloud-based working paper software that uses integrated client data, templates, and guided workflows to prepare, review, and complete accounting files.

productsAndServices.description: A tax workflow product that uses live working-paper data to populate corporation tax returns and schedules and supports efficient preparation and filing.
productsAndServices.name: Corporation Tax

productsAndServices.description: Portfolio-wide financial analysis for accounting firms, enabling teams to query client data, identify trends and risks, and support proactive advisory conversations.
productsAndServices.name: Insights

productsAndServices.description: An AI tool for accountants that analyzes client files, detects anomalies and compliance risks, explains findings, and suggests possible corrective actions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $30,000,000, or 86.96% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,609,052 to $103,340,238, a 28.63x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 81 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 21 (-18).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
